brief.tc: 目前有四個地區的水供應暫停，分別是中西區、九龍城區、元朗區和北區。十八間醫院的等候時間中，屯門醫院最長為五個半鐘，伊利沙伯醫院和將軍澳醫院各為五個鐘。海灘水質方面，有二十九個海灘的水質評級為一級，十一個為二級。空氣質素指數為五，風速最高為時速三十八公里。
brief.en: There are currently four districts with water supply suspension: Central and Western District, Kowloon City District, Yuen Long District, and North District. Among eighteen hospitals, the longest waiting time is five and a half hours at Tuen Mun Hospital, while Queen Elizabeth Hospital and Tseung Kwan O Hospital each have a waiting time of five hours. In terms of beach water quality, twenty-nine beaches are rated level one and eleven are rated level two. The air quality index is five, with a maximum wind speed of thirty-eight kilometers per hour.
